reference.configuration: Original Curtatone-class destroyer profile: raised forecastle, compact bridge, two unequal funnels, two twin 102 mm mounts at the ends and two triple 450 mm torpedo mounts abaft the funnels. Class-specific profile and plan used to check the mount ordering; minor 1940 AA details from the later reference are not portrayed as the original outfit.
reference.note: Stylized class interpretation guided by catalog dimensions, armament and the linked recognition reference; not an engineering plan or exact reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
